about_the_game:
Bring revolution to the skies in this party-based deckbuilder with roguelite storytelling. Navigate treacherous sky islands, build unique decks for a crew of unlikely heroes and breach the storm to uncover the true cost of power.

[DISCLAIMER: VISUALS SUBJECT TO CHANGE]

A New Spin On Turn-Based Combat

In Against All Skies, you can advance or delay party members during combat to achieve Resonance turns. Empowered by this teamwork, characters gain more tactical variety and activate enhanced abilities.

Experiment with new combos to unlock the full potential of your party as they venture into the unknown.

Master Your Favourite Characters

Each member of your party has unique cards and mechanics, and their turn order can differ with each run. Adjust each character’s role and build to maximise their effectiveness in combat.

New cards and events can be discovered depending on the composition of your party, leading to new challenges and rewards.

More Than A Node Map

Choose your own path through the skies as you fly your royal airship, the Helmholtz, between different islands, each with their own unique traits and environments. These biomes can help or hinder your plans to reach the eye of the storm.

With procedurally generated nodes and a new formation each run, experience an endlessly replayable sequence of sky islands.

Features

  • Assemble up to 10 different combinations of characters for your party

  • Enjoy endlessly different deckbuilding approaches and experiment with hundreds of cards

  • Dive into a dynamic turn-based combat system leading to unexpected advantages and combos when Resonating with your party

  • Navigate through different island environments that bring their own challenges and rewards each run

  • Unlock party-enhancing artifacts or character-specific gadgets

  • Experience a rich world and cast of characters with their own personal journeys

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1gb VRAM, OpenGL 3.0 support
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
